about.title: About Priority Towing Houston
text: Stranded on the highway or stuck in a lot? Priority Towing deploys fast — 24 hours a day, 7 days a week — from three yards in Houston, La Porte, and Pasadena, covering the greater Houston Metro and the Bayport / ship-channel area. American owned, fully licensed, and on the road the moment you call.

From a flat tire on the freeway to overturned semis on I-10 — Priority Towing has the equipment and licensed operators to handle every job, every time. We have every Class of Wrecker, Transport, Crane, and Recovery vehicle ready for any event. Crews roll from both our Houston and La Porte yards for faster ETAs across the metro and the Bayport / ship-channel corridor.
Box trucks, delivery vehicles, and mid-size commercial vehicles from 16,001–26,000 lbs. We've got the right rigging for the job.
